children: Overview
Hong Kong molybdenum miner's interim revenue fell 8% yr/yr due to FX effects
Net profit surged, mainly from gain on disposal of discontinued operations
Company highlights material uncertainties about going concern due to net current liabilities
Outlook
Company says economic outlook remains uncertain in second half of 2026
North Mining expects demand for molybdenum in China to keep increasing
Company will continue to invest in technological refinements to secure long-term margins
Result Drivers
FX TRANSLATION EFFECTS - Co said revenue decline was entirely due to foreign exchange translation effects between Renminbi and HK$, with underlying sales performance stable
DISPOSAL GAIN – Profit rose to HK$499.1 mln, mainly attributable to a HK$375.3 mln gain on disposal of the chemical and metal products operation

HIGHER SELLING PRICES AND EFFICIENCY - Co said stronger global market for molybdenum concentrate pushed average selling prices higher, and improved plant efficiency resulted in increased net profit compared to prior period
